ThingDef.label: domed atrium skylight (2x2)
ThingDef.description: A small domed glass atrium ceiling. It opens a two-by-two span of roof to the full sky — bright enough to grow crops by daylight, dark at night — and passes true sunlight for Biotech genes. Cast from structural glass panes set in a frame of structural supports. It won't work under thick overhead mountain.
